# m68k, Motorola syntax, against `m68k-elf-as --mri` (which assumes a 68020).
#
# Motorola source is column-sensitive: a word in column 0 is a label. Every
# instruction here is indented.
#
# Left out on purpose, because rsasm and GNU as legitimately differ:
#   - GNU as substitutes instructions: `move.l #1,d0` becomes `moveq`,
#     `add.w #1,(a0)` becomes `addq`, and `cmp`/`and`/`or #imm,dn` become the
#     `I` forms. rsasm assembles what is written; see m68k-vasm.txt.
#   - `(a0,d1)` with no index size is a long to GNU as and a word to Motorola,
#     vasm and rsasm.
#   - `(pc)` or `8(pc)` with a constant, which GNU as `--mri` reads as an
#     absolute address to relocate; and `label` as an absolute address, which
#     GNU as turns into a PC-relative reference when it can.
#   - `bhs`/`blo` without a size, which GNU as alone never relaxes.

# ---- the Amiga DMACON idiom ----
 move.w #$7fff,$DFF096
 MOVE.W #$7FFF,$DFF096
 move.w #$8200,$dff096

# ---- every addressing mode as a MOVE source ----
 move.w d1,d0
 move.w a1,d0
 move.w (a1),d0
 move.w (a1)+,d0
 move.w -(a1),d0
 move.w 4(a1),d0
 move.w -4(a1),d0
 move.w (4,a1),d0
 move.w 4(a1,d2.w),d0
 move.w 4(a1,d2.l),d0
 move.w -128(a1,a2.w),d0
 move.w 127(a1,a2.l),d0
 move.w (a1,d2.w),d0
 move.w $400,d0
 move.w $400.w,d0
 move.w $400.l,d0
 move.w $DFF006,d0
 move.w #1234,d0
 move.w (pc,d1.w),d0

# ---- every addressing mode as a MOVE destination ----
 move.l d0,d7
 move.l d0,(a7)
 move.l d0,(a7)+
 move.l d0,-(a7)
 move.l d0,-(sp)
 move.l (sp)+,d0
 move.l d0,32767(a6)
 move.l d0,-32768(a6)
 move.l d0,10(a5,d3.w)
 move.l d0,10(a5,d3.l)
 move.l d0,$7ffe
 move.l d0,$8000
 move.l d0,$ffff8000
 move.l d0,-2
 move.l d0,$12345678

# ---- sizes ----
 move.b d0,d1
 move.b #$ff,d0
 move.b #-128,d0
 move.b #'A',d0
 move.w #'AB',d0
 move.l #'ABCD',d0
 move #1,d0
 movew #1,d0
 movel d0,d1
 moveb d0,d1
 move.w #-32768,d0
 move.w #$ffff,d0
 move.l #-2147483648,d1
 move.l #$12345678,(a0)

# ---- MOVEA and moves to address registers ----
 move.l d0,a0
 move.w d0,a0
 move.l (a0)+,a1
 movea.l d0,a0
 movea.w (a0),a1
 movea d0,a1
 move.l a7,a0
 move.l sp,a6
 move.l #$12345678,a0
 move.w #1,a0

# ---- MOVEQ ----
 moveq #0,d0
 moveq #1,d0
 moveq #-1,d7
 moveq #127,d3
 moveq #-128,d4
 moveq.l #42,d2

# ---- MOVE to and from sr, ccr, usp ----
 move sr,d0
 move.w sr,(a0)
 move d0,sr
 move.w #$2700,sr
 move #0,ccr
 move (a0),ccr
 move.w d0,ccr
 move ccr,d0
 move usp,a0
 move a0,usp
 move.l a7,usp
 move.l usp,a7

# ---- MOVEM ----
 movem.l d0-d3/a0-a2,-(sp)
 movem.l (sp)+,d0-d3/a0-a2
 movem.l d0,-(sp)
 movem.l (sp)+,d0
 movem.w d0/d2/a5,(a0)
 movem.l 8(a0),d0-a6
 movem.l d0-d7/a0-a6,-(a7)
 movem.l (a7)+,d0-d7/a0-a6
 movem.l #$0003,(a0)
 movem #$0003,(a0)
 movem.l (a0),#$0003
 movem.l a0-a1/d0-d1,(a0)
 movem.l d3-d0,(a0)
 movem.l a7,-(sp)
 movem.l d0-a0,-(sp)
 movem.w (a0)+,d0/a1
 movem.l d2-d7/a2-a6,-(sp)
 movem.l (sp)+,d2-d7/a2-a6

# ---- LEA, PEA, EXG, SWAP, CLR, EXT ----
 lea (a0),a1
 lea 4(a0),a1
 lea 0(a0),a1
 lea -4(a0,d0.w),a1
 lea $400.w,a1
 lea $12345678,a1
 pea (a0)
 pea 4(a0)
 pea $400
 exg d0,d1
 exg a0,a1
 exg d0,a1
 exg a1,d0
 exg sp,d0
 swap d0
 swap d7
 clr.b d0
 clr.w (a0)
 clr.l -(a0)
 clr (a0)+
 clr.l $400.w
 ext.w d0
 ext.l d0
 ext d0
 extb.l d0

# ---- ADD, ADDA, ADDI, ADDQ, ADDX ----
 add.b d0,d1
 add.w (a0),d1
 add.l d0,(a0)
 add.w d0,-(a7)
 add.w a0,d0
 add.l d0,a0
 add.l a0,d0
 add.w d0,a0
 add.l #$10000,4(a0)
 adda.l d0,a0
 adda.w d0,a0
 adda.w #1,a0
 adda.l #$10000,a0
 adda d0,a0
 addi.b #1,d0
 addi.w #1,(a0)
 addi.l #1,-(sp)
 addi #1,d0
 addq.w #1,d0
 addq.l #8,a0
 addq #1,(a0)
 addq.b #5,$400.w
 addx.b d0,d1
 addx.l -(a0),-(a1)
 addx d2,d3

# ---- SUB, SUBA, SUBI, SUBQ, SUBX ----
 sub.b d0,d1
 sub.l (a0)+,d1
 sub.w d1,(a0)
 sub.l a0,a1
 suba.l a1,a0
 suba.w (a0),a0
 subi.w #1,4(a0)
 subi.l #$12345678,d0
 sub.w #$100,(a1)
 subq.b #8,d7
 subq.l #1,a7
 subq #2,(a0)+
 subx.w d0,d1
 subx.w -(a0),-(a1)

# ---- CMP, CMPA, CMPI, CMPM ----
 cmp.b (a0),d0
 cmp.l d0,d1
 cmp.l a0,d1
 cmp.w d0,a0
 cmp.l a0,a1
 cmp.w #1,(a0)
 cmpa.l a0,a1
 cmpa.w #1,a0
 cmpi.b #1,d0
 cmpi.l #1,(a0)
 cmpi.w #$7fff,$400.w
 cmpm.b (a0)+,(a1)+
 cmpm (a0)+,(a1)+
 cmpm.l (a2)+,(a3)+

# ---- AND, OR, EOR and their I forms; NOT, NEG, NEGX ----
 and.w d0,d1
 and.w d0,(a0)
 and.w (a0),d0
 and.b #$0f,(a0)
 andi.b #1,d0
 andi.w #1,(a0)
 or.b d0,(a0)+
 or.l (a0)+,d0
 or.w #$8000,(a0)
 ori.l #1,d0
 eor.l d0,d1
 eor.w d0,(a0)
 eor.w #1,d0
 eor.b #$ff,(a0)
 eori.b #1,(a0)
 not.b d0
 not.w (a0)
 not.l d7
 neg.l d0
 neg.b (a0)+
 negx.w d0
 negx.l -(a0)

# ---- BCD ----
 abcd d0,d1
 abcd -(a0),-(a1)
 sbcd d0,d1
 sbcd -(a2),-(a3)
 nbcd d0
 nbcd (a0)

# ---- multiply and divide ----
 mulu d0,d1
 mulu.w (a0),d1
 muls.w #3,d1
 muls d2,d3
 divu d0,d1
 divu.w #10,d0
 divs.w #3,d1
 divs 4(a0),d2
 mulu.l d0,d1
 muls.l d0,d1
 mulu.l d0,d2:d1
 muls.l (a0),d3:d4
 divu.l d0,d1
 divs.l d0,d1
 divs.l d0,d2:d1
 divul.l d0,d2:d1
 divsl.l d0,d2:d1
 divsl d0,d2:d1
 divul d0,d2:d1
 divsl.l d0,d1

# ---- TST, TAS, CHK ----
 tst.b d0
 tst.w (a0)
 tst.l -(sp)
 tst.l a0
 tst $400.w
 tas d0
 tas (a0)
 chk d0,d1
 chk.w (a0),d1
 chk.l d0,d1
 chk #100,d2

# ---- shifts and rotates ----
 asl.b #1,d0
 asl.w #8,d1
 asl.l #3,d7
 asl.w d1,d0
 asl.l d2,d3
 asl.w (a0)
 asl (a0)
 asr.b #1,d0
 asr.w d1,d0
 asr.w (a0)
 asr.l #8,d0
 lsl.l #1,d0
 lsl.w d0,d1
 lsl.w 4(a0)
 lsr.b #2,d0
 lsr.l d0,d1
 lsr.w -(a0)
 rol.w #1,d0
 rol.l d0,d1
 rol.w (a0)+
 ror.b #8,d0
 ror.w d0,d1
 ror.w $400
 roxl.w #1,d0
 roxl.b d0,d1
 roxl.w (a0)
 roxr.l #5,d0
 roxr.w d0,d1
 roxr.w $1234.w

# ---- bit operations ----
 btst #3,d0
 btst #31,d0
 btst #3,(a0)
 btst d1,d0
 btst d1,(a0)
 btst d0,#5
 btst #7,$bfe001
 bset #7,d0
 bset d1,-(a0)
 bclr #0,(a0)+
 bclr d2,d3
 bchg #5,$400.w
 bchg d0,d1
 btst.b #3,(a0)
 btst.l #3,d0
 bset.b #7,(a0)
 bclr.l #1,d7

# ---- Scc ----
 st d0
 sf d0
 shi d0
 sls d0
 scc d0
 scs (a0)
 sne d0
 seq d0
 svc d0
 svs d0
 spl d0
 smi d0
 sge d0
 slt d0
 sgt d0
 sle -(a0)
 seq.b d0

# ---- jumps, returns, traps ----
 jmp (a0)
 jmp 4(a0)
 jmp $400.w
 jmp 4(a0,d0.w)
 jmp $fc0000
 jsr (a0)
 jsr -198(a6)
 jsr -552(a6)
 jsr $12345678
 rts
 rte
 rtr
 rtd #4
 trap #0
 trap #15
 trapv
 illegal
 nop
 reset
 stop #$2700
 bkpt #1
 bkpt #7

# ---- LINK, UNLK ----
 link a6,#-4
 link a5,#0
 link.w a6,#-4
 link.l a6,#-100000
 link a6,#-100000
 link a6,#32768
 unlk a6
 unlk a5

# ---- ANDI, ORI, EORI to sr and ccr ----
 andi #$f8ff,sr
 andi.w #$f8ff,sr
 andi #$fe,ccr
 andi.b #$fe,ccr
 ori #$0700,sr
 ori #1,ccr
 eori #1,ccr
 eori #$2000,sr
 and.w #$f8ff,sr
 or.b #1,ccr

# ---- MOVEC ----
 movec d0,vbr
 movec vbr,a0
 movec.l sfc,d1
 movec cacr,d0
 movec a1,usp

# ---- 68020 addressing ----
 move.w (a0,d1.w*2),d0
 move.w (8,a0,d1.l*4),d0
 move.w (a0,d1.w*8),d0
 move.w 1000(a0,d0.w),d1
 move.w 40000(a0),d1
 move.w (40000,a0,d1.w),d0
 move.w (8,d1.w),d0
 move.w (d1.w),d0
 move.w (d1.l*4),d0
 move.l ([8,a0],d1.w,4),d0
 move.l ([8,a0,d1.w],4),d0
 move.l ([a0]),d0
 move.l ([4,a0]),d0

# ---- bit fields and CHK2/CMP2 ----
 bftst d0{1:8}
 bfextu d0{1:8},d1
 bfexts (a0){d1:d2},d3
 bfins d1,(a0){0:32}
 bfset 4(a0){3:5}
 bfclr d7{31:1}
 bfchg (a0){d0:8}
 bfffo d2{0:32},d3
 cmp2.l (a0),d0
 chk2.w (a0),d0
 cmp2.b 4(a0),a1

# ---- the 68881, the 68851 and the rest of the 68020 set ----
# Extended and packed float immediates are in m68k-vasm-020.txt: GNU as
# --mri writes the first differently and refuses the second. `pflusha`
# is left out, since GNU as --mri takes the first form of an instruction
# without operands whatever the CPU, and so assembles the 68040's.
 fmove.x fp0,fp1
 fmove.x fp7,fp0
 fadd.x fp1,fp2
 fsub.x fp3,fp4
 fmul.x fp5,fp6
 fdiv.x fp7,fp0
 fsqrt.x fp0,fp1
 fabs.x fp2
 fneg.x fp3,fp3
 fmove.l d0,fp0
 fmove.w d1,fp2
 fmove.b d2,fp3
 fmove.l fp0,d0
 fmove.w fp1,d1
 fmove.b fp2,d2
 fmove.x (a0),fp0
 fmove.x fp0,(a0)
 fmove.x (a0)+,fp1
 fmove.x fp1,-(a7)
 fmove.d $10(a0),fp2
 fmove.s fp3,$20(a1)
 fmove.x 4(a0,d0.w),fp4
 fmove.x 4(a0,d0.l*4),fp5
 fmove.l #1,fp0
 fmove.w #$1234,fp0
 fmove.b #$12,fp0
 fmove.l fpcr,d0
 fmove.l d0,fpcr
 fmove.l fpsr,(a0)
 fmove.l fpiar,d1
 fmovem.x fp0-fp3,-(a7)
 fmovem.x (a7)+,fp0-fp3
 fmovem.x fp0/fp2/fp4,(a0)
 fmovem.x (a0),fp1/fp3
 fmovem.l fpcr/fpsr,-(a7)
 fmovem.l (a7)+,fpcr/fpsr
 fmovem.l fpcr/fpsr/fpiar,(a0)
 fmovecr #$32,fp0
 fmovecr #0,fp1
 fsincos.x fp0,fp1:fp2
 fsincos.x (a0),fp3:fp4
 ftst.x fp0
 ftst.l d0
 ftst.x (a0)
 fint.x fp0,fp1
 fintrz.x fp2
 fetox.x fp0,fp1
 flogn.x fp2,fp3
 fsin.x fp0
 fcos.x fp1
 ftan.x fp2
 fatan.x fp3
 fgetexp.x fp0,fp1
 fgetman.x fp2,fp3
 fscale.l d0,fp0
 fmod.x fp1,fp2
 frem.x fp3,fp4
 fsgldiv.x fp0,fp1
 fsglmul.x fp2,fp3
 fnop
 fsave -(a7)
 frestore (a7)+
 fseq d0
 fsne (a0)
 fsgt -(a7)
 fsf d1
 fst d2
 ftrapeq
 ftrapne.w #1
 ftrapgt.l #$12345678
 fmove.p fp0,(a0){#5}

 pmove tc,(a0)
 pmove (a0),tc
 pmove crp,(a1)
 pmove srp,-(a7)
 pmove psr,d0
 pmove d0,psr
 pflush #1,#2
 pflush #1,#2,(a0)
 ptestr #1,(a0),#7
 ptestw #1,(a0),#7,a1
 pvalid val,(a0)
 psave -(a7)
 prestore (a7)+
 cas.b d0,d1,(a0)
 cas.w d2,d3,(a1)
 cas.l d4,d5,(a2)
 cas2.w d0:d1,d2:d3,(a0):(a1)
 cas2.l d0:d1,d2:d3,(a0):(a1)
 callm #0,(a0)
 rtm d0

 moves.b (a0),d0

 moves.l (a2)+,a3
 fmove.s #1.5,fp0
 fmove.d #1.5,fp0
 fmove.s #-0.1,fp1
 fmove.d #2.718281828,fp1
 fadd.s #0.5,fp1
 fsub.d #100.25,fp2
